cases.name: restart_marker_before_sos
cases.what: a standalone RST marker ahead of the scan

cases.name: eoi_before_sos
cases.what: a JPEG that ends before it carries any image

cases.name: soi_eoi_only
cases.what: four bytes: an empty JPEG
cases.divergence: ScoreScanPageEncoder requires more than 4 bytes; jpegHeadVerdict reaches EOI and says ok.

cases.name: soi_only
cases.what: two bytes

cases.name: three_bytes
cases.what: FF D8 FF and nothing else

cases.name: fill_bytes_before_sos
cases.what: two fill bytes ahead of the scan marker
cases.divergence: jpegHeadVerdict skips repeated 0xFF; the encoder reads the next two bytes as a length.

cases.name: fill_bytes_before_app0
cases.what: a fill byte ahead of the first segment
cases.divergence: Same fill-byte rule, reached before any segment.

cases.name: soi_repeated_in_stream
cases.what: a second SOI between the segments
cases.divergence: jpegHeadVerdict treats a repeated SOI as standalone; the encoder reads a length after it.

cases.name: zero_marker
cases.what: FF 00, which is a stuffed byte and not a marker

cases.name: segment_length_zero
cases.what: a declared segment length of 0

cases.name: segment_length_one
cases.what: a declared segment length of 1

cases.name: segment_runs_past_end
cases.what: a segment that declares more bytes than the file holds

cases.name: no_sos_at_all
cases.what: a header that stops before the scan

cases.name: not_jpeg_pdf
cases.what: a PDF renamed to .jpg

cases.name: empty
cases.what: no bytes

cases.name: icc_multichunk_under_head
cases.what: a two-chunk ICC profile that fits in the gate's head

cases.name: icc_multichunk_over_head
cases.what: a two-chunk ICC profile larger than the gate's 64 KiB head
cases.divergence: The encoder keeps every ICC chunk; the commit gate never reaches SOS and answers 415 forever.
